```{r}
#都還很粗糙，純ChatGPT寫完就貼上

#==============================================================
#UMAP analysis for Cell-Death Metabolomics Data (POS + NEG)
# Input:
#   5x Blank filtered measurement data
# Output:
#   PNG UMAP plot with group ellipses
#==============================================================


#----0. load packages----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 載入 UMAP 與作圖需要的 packages。
#
# tidyverse:
#   data processing + ggplot2
# umap:
#   UMAP dimensionality reduction
install.packages("umap")

library(tidyverse)
library(umap)


#----1. set paths----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 設定 input / output 的資料夾。
#
# project_path:
#   你的 metabolomics project 主資料夾。
# input_path:
#   前面整理好的 5x Blank filtered measurement data。
# output_path:
#   UMAP 結果會輸出到這裡。

project_path <- "/Users/wangjie/Desktop/LAB/1_Data/5.1_ (Re-analyze) Metabolomic"

input_path <- file.path(
  project_path,
  "0_Raw Data",
  "1_Data(reanalysis)_Celldeath_Sup_Each_Filtered"
)

output_path <- file.path(
  project_path,
  "3_UMAP_Filtered_Measurement_POS_NEG"
)

dir.create(output_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)


#----2. import filtered measurement data----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 讀入 POS / NEG 的 5x Blank filtered measurement table。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# POS_measure:
#   POS mode 中，通過 5x Blank filter 的 measurement features。
# NEG_measure:
#   NEG mode 中，通過 5x Blank filter 的 measurement features。

POS_measure <- read_csv(
  file.path(input_path, "1_Filtered(5xBlank)_POS_Measure.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

NEG_measure <- read_csv(
  file.path(input_path, "1_Filtered(5xBlank)_NEG_Measure.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


#----3. define sample columns----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 指定要放進 UMAP 的 sample columns。
#
# 注意：
# Blank 不放進 UMAP。
# UMAP 要看的是 DMSO / cell death conditions 的 sample relationship。

sample_cols <- c(
  "DMSO-1", "DMSO-2", "DMSO-3",
  "STS-1", "STS-2", "STS-3",
  "Fas-1", "Fas-2", "Fas-3",
  "RSL-1", "RSL-2", "RSL-3",
  "Nec-1", "Nec-2", "Nec-3"
)

stopifnot(all(sample_cols %in% colnames(POS_measure)))
stopifnot(all(sample_cols %in% colnames(NEG_measure)))


#----4. create POS + NEG feature table----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. POS 和 NEG feature 合併。
# 2. 用 Mode + Compound 建立 Feature_ID，避免 POS/NEG feature 名稱撞在一起。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# feature_table:
#   row = mass spectrometry feature
#   column = sample intensity

POS_feature <- POS_measure %>%
  select(Compound, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_ID = paste0("POS_", Compound)
  ) %>%
  select(Feature_ID, all_of(sample_cols))

NEG_feature <- NEG_measure %>%
  select(Compound, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_ID = paste0("NEG_", Compound)
  ) %>%
  select(Feature_ID, all_of(sample_cols))

feature_table <- bind_rows(
  POS_feature,
  NEG_feature
) %>%
  distinct(Feature_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(
  feature_table,
  file.path(output_path, "1_UMAP_input_feature_table_POS_NEG_filtered.csv")
)


#----5. build UMAP input matrix----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 把 feature_table 轉成 numeric matrix。
# 2. row = feature
# 3. column = sample
# 4. log2(x + 1) transformation
# 5. transpose 成 row = sample, column = feature
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# umap_input:
#   UMAP 實際使用的 sample-by-feature matrix。

feature_matrix <- feature_table %>%
  column_to_rownames("Feature_ID") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

log_feature_matrix <- log2(feature_matrix + 1)

# 移除沒有變異的 features
feature_sd <- apply(log_feature_matrix, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

log_feature_matrix_filtered <- log_feature_matrix[feature_sd > 0, ]

umap_input <- t(log_feature_matrix_filtered)

# scaling：讓每個 feature 對 UMAP 的權重比較接近
umap_input_scaled <- scale(umap_input)

zero_variance_summary <- tibble(
  Total_features_before_zero_variance_filter = nrow(log_feature_matrix),
  Features_after_zero_variance_filter = nrow(log_feature_matrix_filtered),
  Removed_zero_variance_features = nrow(log_feature_matrix) - nrow(log_feature_matrix_filtered)
)

write_csv(
  zero_variance_summary,
  file.path(output_path, "2_Zero_variance_filter_summary.csv")
)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(umap_input_scaled) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample"),
  file.path(output_path, "2_UMAP_scaled_sample_by_feature_matrix.csv")
)


#----6. prepare sample annotation----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 建立每個 sample 對應到哪一組 death condition。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# sample_annotation:
#   每個 sample 的 Condition / Group_label。

sample_annotation <- tibble(
  Sample = rownames(umap_input_scaled)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample, "^DMSO") ~ "DMSO",
      str_detect(Sample, "^STS") ~ "STS",
      str_detect(Sample, "^Fas") ~ "Fas",
      str_detect(Sample, "^RSL") ~ "RSL",
      str_detect(Sample, "^Nec") ~ "Nec",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    Group_label = case_when(
      Condition == "DMSO" ~ "control",
      Condition == "STS" ~ "intrinsic apoptosis",
      Condition == "Fas" ~ "extrinsic apoptosis",
      Condition == "RSL" ~ "ferroptosis",
      Condition == "Nec" ~ "necroptosis",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    Replicate = str_extract(Sample, "\\d+$")
  )

sample_annotation$Group_label <- factor(
  sample_annotation$Group_label,
  levels = c(
    "control",
    "intrinsic apoptosis",
    "extrinsic apoptosis",
    "ferroptosis",
    "necroptosis"
  )
)

write_csv(
  sample_annotation,
  file.path(output_path, "3_Sample_annotation.csv")
)


#----7. set UMAP configuration----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 設定 UMAP 參數。
#
# n_neighbors:
#   因為你每組只有 n = 3，總共 15 個 samples。
#   n_neighbors 不宜太大。
#
# min_dist:
#   越小群聚越緊。
#
# metric:
#   euclidean，適合已經 scale 過的 continuous intensity matrix。
#
# random_state:
#   固定 seed，讓 UMAP 結果可重現。

set.seed(1)

umap_config <- umap.defaults
umap_config$n_neighbors <- 3
umap_config$min_dist <- 0.15
umap_config$metric <- "euclidean"
umap_config$random_state <- 1


#----8. run UMAP----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 正式執行 UMAP。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# umap_result:
#   UMAP model。
# umap_score:
#   每個 sample 在 UMAP1 / UMAP2 上的位置。

umap_result <- umap(
  umap_input_scaled,
  config = umap_config
)

umap_score <- as.data.frame(umap_result$layout) %>%
  setNames(c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = rownames(umap_input_scaled)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_annotation,
    by = "Sample"
  )

write_csv(
  umap_score,
  file.path(output_path, "4_UMAP_score_POS_NEG_filtered.csv")
)


#----9. calculate group centers for text labels----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 計算每一組的 UMAP 中心點。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# group_centers:
#   用來放大字 group label 的座標。

group_centers <- umap_score %>%
  group_by(Group_label) %>%
  summarise(
    UMAP1 = mean(UMAP1),
    UMAP2 = mean(UMAP2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


#----10. define colors----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 定義每一組的顏色，接近你提供的範例圖。

group_colors <- c(
  "control" = "#ff7f00",
  "intrinsic apoptosis" = "#1f77b4",
  "extrinsic apoptosis" = "#e377c2",
  "ferroptosis" = "#bcbd22",
  "necroptosis" = "#17becf"
)


#----11. plot UMAP with ellipses----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 畫出每個 sample 的 UMAP 座標。
# 2. 使用 stat_ellipse 畫每組圈圈。
# 3. 加上大字 group labels。
#
# 注意：
# 每組只有 n = 3，所以 ellipse 只是視覺輔助，不是統計信賴區間。

umap_plot <- ggplot(
  umap_score,
  aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = Group_label, fill = Group_label)
) +
  stat_ellipse(
    geom = "polygon",
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.80,
    alpha = 0.18,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(
    data = group_centers,
    aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, label = Group_label, color = Group_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "A UMAP visualization of the Cell-Death Metabolite Dataset (POS + NEG)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "5x Blank filtered features: ",
      nrow(log_feature_matrix_filtered),
      ", n = 3"
    ),
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  )

umap_plot


#----12. save UMAP plot as PNG----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 把 UMAP 圖存成 PNG。

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_path, "5_UMAP_POS_NEG_filtered_with_ellipses.png"),
  plot = umap_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)


#----13. save UMAP object----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 把 UMAP model 存成 RDS，之後可以重新讀取。

saveRDS(
  umap_result,
  file.path(output_path, "6_UMAP_result_POS_NEG_filtered.rds")
)
```
